body:
Adds native Android/iOS builds and responsive interfaces for phones, tablets, desktop and browsers. Touch gameplay now uses compact purple-and-gold overlays, persistent minimap navigation, drag placement with tap-and-confirm as an alternative, a contextual building inspector, and dedicated flags/zone tools. The map and campaign editors use persistent painting palettes and purpose-built editing views. Results use one chart with metric and team filters across desktop and touch.

The presentation changes share game actions and preserve existing simulation rules, orders, save formats and protocol versions. Desktop mouse behavior is retained outside the results redesign; the enlarged flag-selection target is touch-only. Placement, painting and interrupted gestures have explicit ownership and cancellation. Platform work covers startup assets, native text input, safe areas, physical-resolution text rendering, and canonical app icons.

The review gallery compares named screens at phone, tablet and desktop sizes and includes populated game/replay fixtures and scripted interaction recordings. Follow-up playtesting tightened palettes and inspectors, added held-placement edge panning, corrected safe-area overlap, and fixed zone outlines at fractional zoom. The maintainer reports that the Android build plays well in extended hands-on use.

Final cleanup consolidates development overrides under `GLOB2_MOBILE_UI`, gives the form adapter named row kinds and explicit held-action state, and completes 119 additional UI keys across all 33 language catalogs. Translated editor/results actions and empty text prompts wrap within the existing bounds. Maintained documentation now describes gallery simulation ticks and simulator ownership accurately. Reusable gallery sources, platform assets, fixtures and metadata are retained; development evidence stays off the implementation branch.

A Linux pixel-accuracy failure exposed fractional font-cache scaling. Cached raster dimensions now use the exact screen transform when drawn, with the original pixel-accuracy threshold retained and a nearby-scale reuse case added. The legacy menu-navigation harness now clicks the composed editor-setup Cancel control and fails after a bounded timeout instead of hanging on obsolete widget coordinates. Simulation, serialization and protocol behavior are unchanged by this cleanup.

Validation and limits:

- Current head: `8234d2460`, integrating master through `37ffbcb05`. All three conflicts are resolved, preserving viewport-priority previews, mobile controls, CI caching and mobile browser coverage. The landscape capture harness now presents deferred portable-renderer screenshots. Local preview-queue, landscape scrolling, mobile-presentation, responsive-menu, 30 build-system and four structural checks pass. The integrated browser tests now use the native text field for save naming and an advancing clock for preview deadlines; all four previously failing cases pass locally, and five focused WebGL2 cases pass. The newly added master Echo continuation harness also now preserves its console entry point under Windows main-name remapping; its native behavior and entry-point symbol checks pass. Hosted CI for this final integration revision is pending; the results below identify the prior tested revision.

- Cleanup head before integration: `5073106a8`. Final local checks, all six native settings cases, image review and all nine focused browser cases pass. All 12 hosted checks pass on this revision, including browser/native simulation equivalence: [desktop/browser CI](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/actions/runs/36490642370) and [Android CI](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/actions/runs/36490642368).
- Passing checks: 203 CppUnit cases; strict translations and numbered-placeholder audit; translation and font-coverage tests; 24 UTF-8 wrapping cases; 30 build-system checks; 15 browser unit tests; structural checks. Native gameplay/editor, responsive-menu, presentation, input, portable-renderer and pixel-exact font harnesses pass. All nine focused Chromium/WebGL2 cases pass, covering responsive input, Unicode editing, editor recovery and results flows. Linux software-GL raster checks also pass.
- Hosted browser runs: 96 Chromium software cases, 28 Firefox/WebKit cases, 24 Chromium WebGL2 cases (one existing renderer-specific skip), and both visibility checks passed. Both TLS/persistent-storage deployment tests passed.
- German and Japanese coverage exercises small portrait/landscape inspectors, editor dialogs, constrained keyboard layouts and frontend safe areas. Results/chart captures are included and were visually inspected. Presentation checks assert unchanged action identities and no new game orders or simulation changes.
- No fresh physical Android/iOS or IME qualification is claimed for this cleanup. Earlier Android device and iOS simulator results remain available in the prior evidence; synthetic keyboard insets do not substitute for device testing.
- Merged as `49b0844621847ce75064cf251c7035aca56d5f76`. At merge time, all ten native/Android checks passed; browser CI remained in progress and browser/native equivalence had not yet run. Final hosted validation is not yet complete. The four pre-existing untracked local files remain excluded from commits.


[Final cleanup evidence: native/browser logs, localized captures and before/after results](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/codex/evidence-pr208-cleanup-20260928).

[Prior merge-preparation evidence and device captures](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/codex/evidence-pr208-merge-20260928) records its own revisions, including earlier full browser runs and device results. [Earlier desktop/browser evidence](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/evidence/pr208-responsive-20260925/desktop-regression) and [original mobile-port evidence](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/evidence/pr208-mobile-20260924) likewise predate the cleanup head.
title: Add native mobile builds and responsive UI across native and browser
